name: Fertility and IVF clinics (admin)

problems.words: Coordinators are on WhatsApp all day answering the same timing questions
quick_ideas: List the logistics questions coordinators get most, so the repeats are clear
Ask the clinic to approve one written answer set for logistics only, so everyone answers alike.

workzap_build.text: a WhatsApp flow that answers logistics questions (timings, location, documents to bring) and confirms appointments, routing anything clinical to staff.

problems.ask_first: How many coordinators share the load?
problems.free_stops: The question set and routing are designed in the solution document.

problems.words: When that coordinator is off, nobody knows who is due when
quick_ideas: Move the schedule from one notebook to a shared view using codes rather than names, so cover is possible
Do a short handover note before any leave, so nothing is lost.

workzap_build.text: a coordinator scheduling board by patient code (no names on the shared view) with cover handover notes.

problems.ask_first: Is the schedule kept on paper or software now?
problems.free_stops: Code system and handover rules are in the solution document.

problems.words: Package bills don't include add-ons and patients feel surprised
quick_ideas: Ask finance and the doctors to agree one itemised estimate format, so extras are visible upfront
Review recent disputes, so the common surprises are known.

workzap_build.text: an itemised estimate and billing sheet approved by the clinic, so front desk and coordinators quote the same.

problems.ask_first: Who explains the costs to patients now?
problems.free_stops: Estimate structure is in the solution document.

problems.words: Storage fees go unpaid for years and we don't have a clear list
quick_ideas: Build one list of storage accounts by code with renewal date and amount due, so arrears are known
Ask your lawyer about what you may do with long-overdue accounts, so you don't act on a guess.

workzap_build.text: a storage-fee register with renewal dates, invoices, payments and overdue status, with gentle reminders on schedule.

problems.free_stops: Reminder sequence is in the solution document; storage law is for your lawyer.

problems.words: Instalment payments fall behind and nobody follows up gently
quick_ideas: List open instalment plans with due dates, so overdue ones stand out
Give one person the job of follow-up, so it happens kindly and consistently.

workzap_build.text: an instalment tracker with polite reminders showing only amount and date.

problems.ask_first: Do you offer financing through a third party?
problems.free_stops: Reminder tone and timing are in the solution document.

problems.words: Consent forms are missing signatures on the day of a procedure
quick_ideas: Check next week's procedure dates for pending paperwork, so gaps are found early
Name who chases each document, so it has an owner.

workzap_build.text: a document checklist per procedure date showing which admin items are pending by role, with reminders, never storing consent content.

problems.ask_first: Which documents most often aren't ready?
problems.free_stops: Checklist items are in the solution document; what consent must include is for your doctors and lawyer.

problems.words: Culture media and lab consumables expire or run out
quick_ideas: List critical supplies with expiry and stock on hand, so risks are visible
Note lead times for imported items, so orders go out early enough.

workzap_build.text: a consumables and media register with lot, expiry and reorder levels, plus an import shipment tracker.

problems.ask_first: Which supplies would stop work if they ran out?
problems.free_stops: Reorder levels are worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: Enquiries from abroad come at odd hours and get missed
quick_ideas: Count after-hours enquiries for a week, so the gap is known
Name who answers international enquiries next morning, so each one is picked up.

workzap_build.text: an enquiry inbox with response timers and follow-up reminders, capturing no medical history.

problems.ask_first: Where do most international enquiries come from?
problems.free_stops: Routing set-up is in the solution document.

problems.words: Monthly numbers come from three systems that don't match
quick_ideas: Pick the few monthly admin numbers you need, so reporting stays focused
Name one source for each, so there is one answer.

workzap_build.text: integration — an owner dashboard with enquiries, consultations booked, cycles scheduled, receivables and storage arrears pulled from existing systems.

problems.ask_first: Which systems hold billing and scheduling now?
problems.free_stops: Data connections are mapped in the solution document.

never_say: Anything about treatment options, success chances, medication, embryos, donors or genetic testing.
Interpretations of donor, surrogacy, storage or eligibility law in any country.
Help altering records, back-dating consents or arranging treatment against local law.
Ideas that record names, histories, cycle details or consent content.
Counselling; if a patient writes in distressed, be kind and point to their clinic or emergency services.

sample_reply.person: Our coordinators spend the whole day answering the same WhatsApp questions about timings and what to bring. Can this be solved?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be solved, and you can start this week. 1) List the logistics questions your coordinators get most often, so the repeats are clear. 2) Have the clinic approve one set of logistics answers, so every coordinator says the same thing. Workzap can do this automatically for you with a WhatsApp flow that answers logistics questions and routes anything clinical to your staff. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're welcome to say no.
